question: Wie war der Spielstand nach jedem Viertel im Spiel FC Bayern München gegen Alba Berlin am 10.6.2024?
sql:
WITH q_scores AS (
  SELECT quarter, player_team, SUM(pts) AS pts_in_q
  FROM bronze.b_bbl_playbyplay
  WHERE date = '2024-06-10'
  GROUP BY quarter, player_team
),
cum_scores AS (
  SELECT quarter, player_team, SUM(pts_in_q) OVER (PARTITION BY player_team ORDER BY quarter) AS cum_pts
  FROM q_scores
)
SELECT quarter,
       MAX(CASE WHEN player_team ILIKE '%BAYERN%' THEN cum_pts END) AS bayern,
       MAX(CASE WHEN player_team ILIKE '%ALBA%' THEN cum_pts END) AS alba
FROM cum_scores
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter
doc: There can be multiple games of the same teams. If there are multiple games, calculate the score after each quarter separately for each game and return all results. It is possible that the user does not specify a league. In that case check across all availabe leagues and return all results specifying in which league each game took place.

question: Wie hoch ist die durchschnittliche Dreipunktequote der Spieler in der Champions-League-Saison 2024-25 (mindestens 50 Versuche)?
sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT player_name, SUM(three_pa) AS attempts, SUM(three_p) AS made
  FROM bronze.b_cl_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2024-07-15' AND date < '2025-07-15'
  GROUP BY player_name
  HAVING SUM(three_pa) >= 50
)
SELECT SUM(made) * 100.0 / SUM(attempts) AS avg_three_p_pct, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_players
FROM qualifying
doc: An 'average X, minimum N attempts' question needs a TWO-LEVEL aggregate, not a leaderboard: first collapse to one row per player-season with GROUP BY player_name and HAVING SUM(attempts) >= N (N is a season total, never a per-row WHERE filter - a single game essentially never has 50 three-point attempts, so WHERE three_pa >= 50 silently returns zero rows), then aggregate that qualifying set into the final single number. Do not answer with ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 20 and let the summary step average the returned rows - verified against live data: the true average across all 47 qualifying players is 37.4%, but averaging only the top 20 by percentage gives a biased 43.6%.

question: Welche Spieler in der Bundesliga kommen aus Deutschland?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (btrim(player_name))
       btrim(player_name) AS spieler, player_team, nationality
FROM bronze.b_bbl_player_info
WHERE nationality ILIKE '%Deutschland%'
ORDER BY btrim(player_name)
doc: Country filters must use the spelling of the league's own table, and always ILIKE, never '='. b_bbl_player_info stores nationality in GERMAN with a 2-letter ISO code in brackets, so ILIKE '%Germany%' matches 0 of 859 rows while ILIKE '%Deutschland%' matches 392 - verified against live data. The bracket is not reliable either (260 rows 'Deutschland (DE)', 70 rows plain 'Deutschland'), and dual nationals hold both countries in one cell separated by a newline (86 rows), so a substring match is the only form that catches all three shapes. DISTINCT ON is required because player_info holds one row per crawled season: 392 rows correspond to 304 distinct players. The encoding differs per league - EuroLeague and EuroCup use English full names ('Germany', and EC writes 'Turkiye'), Champions League uses 3-letter codes ('GER') with comma-separated duals - so this literal must be changed per league and a single cross-league country query is not possible.

question: Wie war die Sieg-Niederlage-Bilanz von Real Madrid in der EuroLeague-Saison 2025–2026?
sql:
WITH games AS (
  SELECT link, home_team, away_team,
         MAX(home_team_tot_pts) AS home_pts,
         MAX(away_team_tot_pts) AS away_pts
  FROM bronze.b_el_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15'
  GROUP BY link, home_team, away_team
),
reoriented AS (
  SELECT home_team AS team, home_pts AS team_pts, away_pts AS opp_pts FROM games
  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_team AS team, away_pts AS team_pts, home_pts AS opp_pts FROM games
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(team) = 'REAL MADRID' AND team_pts > opp_pts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(team) = 'REAL MADRID' AND team_pts < opp_pts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
FROM reoriented
WHERE UPPER(team) = 'REAL MADRID'

question: Welches BBL-Team hatte in der Saison 2025–2026 die beste Punktedifferenz pro Spiel (mindestens 20 Spiele)?
sql:
WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT
    player_team AS team,
    link,
    SUM(pts) AS pts_for
  FROM bronze.b_bbl_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15' AND competition = 'easyCredit BBL'
  GROUP BY player_team, link
),
opp_stats AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN player_team = home_team THEN away_team ELSE home_team END AS team,
    link,
    SUM(pts) AS pts_against
  FROM bronze.b_bbl_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15' AND competition = 'easyCredit BBL'
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN player_team = home_team THEN away_team ELSE home_team END, link
)
SELECT
  t.team,
  ROUND((SUM(t.pts_for) - SUM(o.pts_against))::numeric / COUNT(*), 2) AS diff_per_game
FROM team_stats t
JOIN opp_stats o ON t.team = o.team AND t.link = o.link
GROUP BY t.team
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY diff_per_game DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Welches EuroCup-Team erzielte in dieser Saison die meisten Punkte insgesamt?
sql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT CASE home_team
           WHEN 'HAPOEL BANK YAHAV JERUSALEM' THEN 'HAPOEL MIDTOWN JERUSALEM'
           WHEN 'PANIONIOS ATHENS' THEN 'PANIONIOS COSMORAMA TRAVEL ATHENS'
           ELSE home_team
         END AS team,
         link, MAX(home_team_tot_pts) AS pts
  FROM bronze.b_ec_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15'
  GROUP BY home_team, link
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE away_team
           WHEN 'HAPOEL BANK YAHAV JERUSALEM' THEN 'HAPOEL MIDTOWN JERUSALEM'
           WHEN 'PANIONIOS ATHENS' THEN 'PANIONIOS COSMORAMA TRAVEL ATHENS'
           ELSE away_team
         END AS team,
         link, MAX(away_team_tot_pts) AS pts
  FROM bronze.b_ec_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15'
  GROUP BY away_team, link
)
SELECT team, SUM(pts) AS total_pts
FROM normalized
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY total_pts DESC
LIMIT 10
doc: TWO separate required steps, both load-bearing - dropping either one silently corrupts the answer: (1) home_team_tot_pts/away_team_tot_pts repeat on every player row of a game (~23-24 rows per team per game, all identical) - you MUST collapse to one row per team-game first via GROUP BY team, link and MAX(...), never SUM the raw per-player rows directly, or the total overcounts by roughly the roster size (verified: 2073 correct vs 48556 when this step is dropped, a 23x error). (2) Team-level aggregation must ALSO normalize mid-season sponsor-renamed team names to one canonical name via CASE WHEN before grouping, or a renamed team's points silently split across two rows and it drops out of the ranking entirely (verified: HAPOEL MIDTOWN JERUSALEM never appears in the EuroCup top 10 without this; correctly ranks 6th at 1810 combined points with it). Both steps are independent of each other - do not skip the MAX(...) dedup just because a question does not mention renamed teams.

question: Wie viele Führungswechsel gab es im Spiel FC Bayern München gegen Alba Berlin am 10.6.2024?
sql:
WITH PLAY_SCORES AS (
    SELECT
        DATE,
        QUARTER,
        PLAYER_TEAM,
        PTS,

        -- LAUFENDER SPIELSTAND JE TEAM
        SUM(PTS) OVER (
            PARTITION BY DATE, PLAYER_TEAM
            ORDER BY QUARTER
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS TEAM_SCORE

    FROM BRONZE.B_BBL_PLAYBYPLAY
    WHERE DATE = '2024-06-10'
),

SCORES AS (
    SELECT
        DATE,
        QUARTER,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN PLAYER_TEAM ILIKE '%BAYERN%'
            THEN TEAM_SCORE
        END) AS BAYERN_SCORE,

        MAX(CASE
            WHEN PLAYER_TEAM ILIKE '%ALBA%'
            THEN TEAM_SCORE
        END) AS ALBA_SCORE

    FROM PLAY_SCORES
    GROUP BY
        DATE,
        QUARTER
       
),

LEADERS AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN BAYERN_SCORE > ALBA_SCORE THEN 'BAYERN'
            WHEN ALBA_SCORE > BAYERN_SCORE THEN 'ALBA'
            ELSE 'TIE'
        END AS LEADER
    FROM SCORES
),

PREVIOUS_LEADER AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(LEADER) OVER (
            ORDER BY QUARTER
        ) AS PREV_LEADER
    FROM LEADERS
)

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS ANZAHL_FUEHRUNGSWECHSEL
FROM PREVIOUS_LEADER
WHERE LEADER <> 'TIE'
  AND PREV_LEADER <> 'TIE'
  AND LEADER <> PREV_LEADER;

question: Wer war in der BBL-Saison 2025–2026 der beste Rebounder jedes Teams (mindestens 15 Spiele)?
sql:
WITH je_spieler AS (
  SELECT player_team AS team,
         btrim(player_name) AS spieler,
         COUNT(*) AS spiele,
         ROUND(AVG(reb), 2) AS reb_schnitt
  FROM bronze.b_bbl_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15' AND competition = 'easyCredit BBL'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15
),
rang AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY reb_schnitt DESC) AS rn
  FROM je_spieler
)
SELECT team, spieler, spiele, reb_schnitt
FROM rang
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY reb_schnitt DESC
doc: A 'best X per team/group' question needs ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group ORDER BY metric DESC) in a CTE, then WHERE rn = 1 - not a plain GROUP BY, which cannot return the row that produced the maximum. Two traps specific to this database. First, do NOT source this from gold.g_player_profile_*: its pts/reb/trb columns are ALREADY per-game averages, so dividing them by gp again yields rebounds-per-game-per-game, which systematically favours players with few games - verified against live data, that mistake picked the wrong player for 8 of 18 BBL teams. Second, g_player_profile_bbl is incomplete (265 players), so several teams' actual best rebounder does not exist in it at all; any question about coverage across all teams or all players must come from the bronze boxscore. Use player_team for the player's own team - home_team/away_team are the fixture, not the player's team.

question: Was war die höchste Führung im Spiel FC Bayern München gegen Alba Berlin am 10.6.2024
sql:
WITH game_teams AS (
  SELECT home_team, away_team
  FROM bronze.b_bbl_playbyplay
  WHERE date = '2024-06-10'
  LIMIT 1
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    quarter,
    player_team,
    game_time,
    SUM(pts) OVER (PARTITION BY player_team, quarter ORDER BY (split_part(game_time, ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part(game_time, ':', 2)::int) DESC) AS cum_pts
  FROM bronze.b_bbl_playbyplay
  WHERE date = '2024-06-10'
    AND (home_team ILIKE '%FC BAYERN%' OR away_team ILIKE '%ALBA BERLIN%')
),
scores AS (
  SELECT
    c.quarter,
    c.game_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.player_team = g.home_team THEN c.cum_pts END) AS home_pts,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.player_team = g.away_team THEN c.cum_pts END) AS away_pts
  FROM cumulative c
  CROSS JOIN game_teams g
  GROUP BY c.quarter, c.game_time
)
SELECT MAX(ABS(home_pts - away_pts)) AS highest_lead
FROM scores

question: Welche BBL-Spieler hatten in der Saison 2025–2026 das beste Verhältnis von Assists zu Ballverlusten (mindestens 20 Spiele und 50 Assists)?
sql:
WITH player_stats AS (
  SELECT
    player_name,
    SUM(ast) AS total_ast,
    SUM(tov) AS total_tov,
    COUNT(*) AS gp
  FROM bronze.b_bbl_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15' AND competition = 'easyCredit BBL'
  GROUP BY player_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND SUM(ast) >= 50
)
SELECT
  player_name,
  total_ast,
  total_tov,
  ROUND(total_ast::numeric / NULLIF(total_tov, 0), 2) AS ast_tov_ratio
FROM player_stats
ORDER BY ast_tov_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Zeig mir als Streudiagramm Punkte im Verhältnis zu gespielten Minuten für BBL-Spieler.
sql:
SELECT split_part(minutes, ':', 1)::numeric + split_part(minutes, ':', 2)::numeric / 60.0 AS minutes,
       pts,
       player_name,
       player_team
FROM bronze.b_bbl_boxscore
WHERE minutes ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}:[0-9]{2}$'
  AND minutes <> '00:00'
  AND pts IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 500
doc: Boxscore minutes are text in MM:SS format. Convert them to decimal minutes before charting.
